title: 第15章 一见倾心第16章 怎么感觉那么心虚
slug: 脸盲宗主她又抓错人了
content_zh:
此言一出，不仅白露脸上露出了震惊之色。
就连不远处的其他灵族人。
眼中也齐刷刷地掠过一丝茫然。
因为他们也从未听闻过，族中圣物菩提心竟还是王族成员的嫁妆！
白露的全部心神都集中在灵月女王刚才那番惊人话语上。
因此并未注意到周围灵族人的刹那间露出的细微表情。
不过，白露的震惊只持续了短短一瞬。
她迅速平复心绪，那双清冽的凤眸直视灵月，沉声问道：“除了这个条件，难道再无其他途径可以取走菩提心了吗？”
灵月闻言，握着琉璃宝座扶手的手指不由得收紧了几分。
眼底深处，更是划过一丝忐忑。
事实上，灵族祖训中从未有过如此规定！
这不过是她灵机一动，临时编造的托词罢了。
她真正的目的，是想借菩提心，将自己这一双天赋尚可的儿女送到这位化神巅峰强者的身边。
若能攀上如此高枝，灵族便等于拥有了一座坚不可摧的靠山，未来万年无忧！
这无疑是一场豪赌。
她此刻只求这位绝世强者不要看穿其中的端倪。
否则，灵族必将迎来灭顶之灾！
灵月定了定心神，强迫自己维持镇定：“前辈明鉴，菩提心乃我灵族传承圣物，意义非凡。”
“若留于族中，便能助我族多培育一位有望登临巅峰的绝世强者。”
她话锋一转，语气带上几分无奈：“如今前辈欲将其取走，无异于釜底抽薪，我灵族的整体实力必将因此大受折损。”

“正因如此，若有灵族之外的强者执意带走菩提心，则必须同时迎娶我王族成员，缔结姻亲之好。”灵月的目光扫过自己的一双儿女，又落回白露身上。
“唯有依靠与强者建立的这份关系，我灵族方能在这失去圣物庇护的漫长万年时光里，安然渡过可能出现的危机。”
白露听完，再次陷入了沉默。
若拒绝带走这对兄妹，灵月女王显然不会轻易交出菩提心。
而她白露却也并非嗜杀成性的魔头。
总不能为了抢夺菩提心，就将整个灵族屠戮殆尽吧？
权衡再三，白露心中有了决断：不如先假意应承，将这兄妹二人带离灵族。
待回到合欢宗，随便安置个内门弟子的身份即可，也算履行了承诺。
主意已定，白露立刻抬眼，目光平静地看向灵月：“好，那就一言为定。”
此时，脸色有些苍白的灵月听到白露肯定的答复。
才勉强挤出一丝如释重负的微笑。
因为就在刚才白露陷入沉思，脑海中闪过“总不能因为抢夺菩提心，将整个灵族都给灭掉”这个念头时。
content_en:
As soon as these words came out, not only Bai Lu's face showed a look of shock.
Even the other Spirit Tribe people not far away.
A trace of confusion also flashed across his eyes.
Because they have never heard that Bodhicitta, the sacred object of the clan, is actually a dowry for members of the royal family!
Bai Lu's entire mind was focused on Queen Lingyue's shocking words just now.
Therefore, he did not notice the subtle expressions of the surrounding Spirit Race people for a moment.
However, Bai Lu's shock only lasted a short moment.
She quickly calmed down her mind, looked directly at Lingyue with her clear phoenix eyes, and asked in a deep voice: "Apart from this condition, is there no other way to take away bodhicitta?"
Hearing this, Lingyue couldn't help but tighten her fingers on the armrest of the glass throne.
Deep in his eyes, there was even a trace of anxiety.
In fact, there has never been such a provision in the ancestral training of the Spirit Clan!
This was just an excuse she made up on the spur of the moment.
Her real purpose was to use bodhicitta to send her son and daughter, who were both talented, to the side of this powerful man at the peak of god transformation.
If they can climb such a high branch, the Spirit Clan will have an indestructible backer, and they will be worry-free for thousands of years to come!
This is undoubtedly a big gamble.
At this moment, she just begged this extremely powerful man not to see through the clues.
Otherwise, the Spirit Clan will surely face disaster!
Ling Yue calmed down and forced herself to remain calm: "Senior, Bodhicitta has learned clearly that Bodhicitta is the sacred heritage passed down by our Spirit Clan, and it is of extraordinary significance."
"If you stay in the clan, you can help our clan cultivate one more peerless strong man who is expected to reach the top."
She changed the topic and said with a hint of helplessness in her tone: "Now that senior wants to take it away, it is tantamount to draining the bottom of the cauldron, and the overall strength of our spiritual clan will be greatly damaged."
"Because of this, if there is a strong man outside the Spiritual Clan who insists on taking away Bodhicitta, he must marry a member of my royal family at the same time and form a good marriage." Lingyue's eyes glanced at her pair of children, and then fell back on Bai Lu.
"Only by relying on the relationship established with the strong, our spirit clan can safely survive the possible crises during the long period of thousands of years without the protection of sacred objects."
After hearing this, Bai Lu fell into silence again.
If she refuses to take away the siblings, Queen Lingyue will obviously not hand over Bodhicitta easily.
And she, Bai Lu, is not a murderous demon.
You can't just massacre the entire spiritual race just to steal Bodhicitta, right?
After weighing it again and again, Bai Lu made a decision in her heart: It would be better to pretend to agree and take the brother and sister away from the Spiritual Clan.
When he returns to the Hehuan Sect, he can just assume the identity of an inner disciple. This can be regarded as fulfilling his promise.
Having made up his mind, Bai Lu immediately raised his eyes and looked at Lingyue calmly: "Okay, then it's a deal."
At this time, Lingyue, who looked a little pale, heard Bai Lu's affirmative reply.
Only then did he manage to squeeze out a smile of relief.
Because just now Bai Lu was deep in thought, and the thought "We can't destroy the entire spiritual race just because of robbing bodhicitta" flashed through his mind.
